posts.text: Key risks/unknowns: 	•	Catarina (Ventura's drillship) has no contract past 2026 — the single biggest swing variable. 	•	Ventura's yard capex (up to $130m) is still being finalized, and updated guidance in late November literally moves the exchange ratio. 	•	SED has its own re-tendering risk on three rigs over a four-month window (Nov 2026–Jan 2027), and rates have been under pressure. Så åpenbart høyere kurs om nye kontrakter signeres.
